stable.title: Link hooks drawn, bars through the roof beam

notes.x: The link hook (135 or 90 degrees, extension from the selected detailing code) is drawn on the link in every section and on the link in every beam/slab zone of the elevation.
The top-level bars are drawn complete through the roof beam up to the top cover (with the top bend where one is required), as they already crossed the intermediate beams.

history.title: Link hooks drawn, bars through the roof beam

notes.x: The link hook (135 or 90 degrees, extension from the selected detailing code) is drawn on the link in every section and on the link in every beam/slab zone of the elevation.

The Settings and Developer tabs were removed from the program. Publishing new versions is now done only with the separate Release Publisher tool.
The program is smaller and users only see Updates and Release notes.
Desktop and Start-menu shortcuts now carry the same icon as the program window.
improved version from text to number read

history.title: Publish to GitHub from the app

notes.x: Developer tab: Publish to GitHub button uploads the new build and update.json straight to your repository - no manual upload on github.com.
Clear messages when the GitHub token, repository, branch or version number is wrong.
